title: Add Thruster to Docker setup to get HTTP/2, X-Sendfile, Caching by default in Rails 8
one_line_why: Go 1.22’s built‑in HTTP/2 support and Docker multi‑stage builds now simplify proxy integration.
one_line_summary: Add a Thruster proxy to the Rails Docker image to enable HTTP/2, caching, and X-Sendfile by default.
